note: Independent re-judgment on 2026-11-25 against RFC 1997 Well-known Communities ('All routes received carrying a communities attribute containing this value [NO_EXPORT] MUST NOT be advertised outside a BGP confederation boundary (a stand-alone autonomous system that is not part of a confederation should be considered a confederation itself).'). Reviewed all diffs since the prior verdict across rfc1997_forward_wellknown_test.go (wkPeer helper Bus wiring update; tagged unit bodies unchanged), wellknown-no-export-egress.ci, and wellknown-no-export-withdraw-egress.ci (bus/bgp-rib config migration with static 1.1.1.1/32 -> lo, option=needs-linux, external-peer local 127.0.0.13, seq=1 order-independent internal expectations for both 180A0000 and 18C00002, and comment wording in 1f82b2727d). Positive: external peer receives fence 192.0.2.0/24 and rejects 10.0.0.0/24 in both announced and withdrawn scopes, paired with unit tests and checkNoExportBoundary. Negative: internal peer receives both 10.0.0.0/24 (NO_EXPORT) and fence 192.0.2.0/24; wellknown-no-export-withdraw-egress.ci proves the withdrawal half of a mixed UPDATE still reaches the external peer while the NO_EXPORT announcement is rejected. Enforcement is unchanged.
